title: 주식회사 등의 외부감사에 관한 법률 시행규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:11:0:00011:part:1/1

Article 11 (Composition of the Oversight Committee)
① The oversight committee, as defined in Article 44(5) of the Act, shall be composed of 1 chairperson and 8 members, taking into account gender balance.
② The chairperson shall be a person who possesses professional expertise in accounting and the integrity required for fair performance of duties, and shall be appointed by the chairman of the Korean Certified Public Accountants Association (hereinafter referred to as "the Chairman") upon obtaining the consent of the Securities and Exchange Commission.
③ The members of the oversight committee shall be appointed or nominated by the Chairman from among the following:
1. 1 person from among the 4th grade or higher officials of the Financial Services Commission who are responsible for accounting standards-related work.
2. 1 person from among the heads of departments of the Financial Supervisory Service who are responsible for supervision.
3. 1 person from among the heads of departments of the Korean Certified Public Accountants Association who are responsible for supervision.
4. 1 person from among the executives of the Korean Accounting Standards Institute.
5. 1 person who possesses extensive knowledge and experience in accounting and auditing, or related laws, and who has the consent of the Korean Certified Public Accountants Association.
6. A professor in the finance or accounting department of a university.

1. One person recommended by the Korean Institute of Certified Public Accountants.
2. One person recommended by the Korean Chamber of Commerce and Industry, who possesses professional knowledge and practical experience in accounting or auditing.
3. One lawyer with specialized knowledge in accounting or auditing.
④ Regarding the disqualification of members, the provisions of Article 3, Paragraph 6 shall apply.
⑤ The terms of office for the chairperson and members under items 5 to 8 of Article 3 are two years, and they may be re-appointed for one term only. However, even if the term expires, they can continue to perform the duties until a successor is appointed.
⑥ If the chairperson is unable to perform their duties due to unavoidable reasons, a member appointed by the chairperson will perform the duties, and if the chairperson is unable to appoint a member to perform the duties, the chairperson will appoint a member.
⑦ If the Securities and Exchange Commission determines that a member appointed or commissioned under Article 3 has committed an act violating the law, neglected their duties, or otherwise significantly impaired their performance as a member, the chairperson will

It may request clarification.
⑧ In addition to the matters specified in paragraphs 1 through 7, the supervisory committee shall determine all other matters necessary for the composition and operation of the supervisory committee.
